integrity: The proof reduces every degree-\((m-1)\) monomial shadow to an explicit disjoint core-plus-slice decomposition and invokes the source's exact homogeneous shadow theorem. A standalone verifier checks heterogeneous exponent boxes and directly enumerates all subcodes in a nontrivial \(\mathbb F_3\) instance.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the homogeneous edge degree \(d=m-1\) for Cartesian factors containing zero, plus the corresponding projective edge degree. It does not determine full hierarchies at smaller degrees or enumerate all minimizing subcodes.
title: The full edge-degree hierarchy of Cartesian square-free codes
